name: bottom-sheet
description: A titled sheet. Drag, back, or scrim dismisses — there is no close X.
avoidWhen: Do not use for a yes/no decision; use confirm-dialog. Do not add a close icon in the title.

ux.behaviour: A handle and a title sit above the content
ux.why: You know it is a sheet and what it is for

ux.behaviour: Drag, back, or scrim calls onDismiss; there is no close X
ux.why: Leaving a sheet should be the same gesture every time

aiHints: Do not add a close IconButton; onDismiss is the way out
Previews render AppBottomSheetChrome; call AppBottomSheet at runtime
